title: Spymarks, Not Watermarks
summary: The article proposes 'spymarks' as an alternative to traditional watermarks for tracking AI-generated content. Unlike watermarks, which are designed to be detectable and often removable, spymarks aim to be covert, robust, and potentially used for attribution or monitoring without alerting the generator. The Hacker News discussion (488 points, 120 comments) debates the technical, ethical, and practical implications of such hidden markers in LLM outputs.
